overview: The City Council ordained significant zoning changes for the Boston Avenue corridor and passed a resolution supporting legal intervention to defend the city's investment ordinance. The meeting also addressed community safety, environmental initiatives, and municipal fine enforcement.

items.title: Ward 1 Neighborhood Meeting
items.summary: Approved a resolution inviting Ward 1 residents to attend a neighborhood improvement meeting on September 23rd at Andrews Middle School.

items.title: National Recovery Month Resolution
items.summary: Passed a resolution acknowledging September as National Recovery Month and received a presentation on city-sponsored recovery services and harm reduction efforts.

items.title: Memorial Resolution and Meeting Records
items.summary: Observed a moment of silence for former educator Lorraine Marie Miles and approved meeting records and committee reports from early August.

items.title: West Medford Train Station Safety
items.summary: Referred a resolution seeking safety upgrades at the West Medford train station to the Public Health and Community Safety Committee following a recent fatal accident.

items.title: Common Victualler Licenses
items.summary: Approved business licenses for Ebisuya, Moussey and Co., and Rosso’s Grill.

items.title: CPA Appropriation for Berry Park Plantings
items.summary: Approved $8,500 in Community Preservation Act funds for Trees Medford to install native plantings and seating at Berry Park.

items.title: Resolution on ICE Detention of Resident
items.summary: Passed a resolution calling for the immediate release of resident Vijay D'Souza from ICE detention and condemning federal immigration enforcement tactics.

items.title: Boston Avenue Neighborhood Corridor Zoning
items.summary: Ordained the Boston Avenue zoning amendment after resolving debates regarding building step-backs and changing purpose-built student housing to a by-right use in specific subdistricts.

items.title: Legal Intervention in Chertok Litigation
items.summary: Approved a declaration supporting resident or Attorney General intervention in a federal lawsuit to defend the city’s investment ordinance, citing concerns over current legal representation.

items.title: Public Tree Ordinance
items.summary: Ordained the Public Tree Ordinance to establish management standards and protections for trees on city-owned property.

items.title: Law Department Appropriations
items.summary: Tabled the request for Law Department funds until September 29th to allow for the review of newly provided litigation and settlement records.

items.title: Police Chief Hiring Committee
items.summary: Appointed Vice President Lazzaro to represent the City Council on the interview panel for the next police chief.

items.title: Building Height Definition Clarification
items.summary: Approved a resolution clarifying that a standardized building height definition was formally adopted during previous Medford Square rezoning and applies citywide.

items.title: Fine Enforcement and Private Ways
items.summary: Referred resolutions to committee to establish a tax-roll collection process for municipal fines and to develop a communication plan regarding maintenance of private ways.

items.title: Appointments and Litigation Settlement
items.summary: Approved several board appointments and an $11,640 settlement with Sentry Ford for property damage caused by a city vehicle.
